evals.prompt: I'm ED of Green Acres Community Garden Network in Madison, WI — 12 staff, $1.6M. Board adopted a 3-year strategic plan in September with 4 priorities. Our leadership team meetings are status-update marathons and nothing gets done between them. I've read Traction and want to implement EOS starting January. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: A nonprofit EOS rollout anchored in the existing strategic plan: V/TO translated from the plan, Accountability Chart surfacing multi-seat holders, conservative first-quarter Rocks, a sustainable weekly Scorecard, the L10 agenda, and someone besides the ED holding meeting discipline.
assertions: Anchors the V/TO's 3-Year Picture and 1-Year Plan in the board-adopted strategic plan's priorities rather than re-deriving vision
Builds an Accountability Chart with functional seats, one name per seat, flags people holding 3+ seats, and addresses whether the ED is Visionary, Integrator or a hybrid
Recommends a conservative first quarter of 3–5 organizational Rocks, each with one owner and a binary done definition
Describes a Scorecard of weekly leading indicators with targets designed with the finance/data lead so numbers can be pulled weekly without a manual scramble
Lays out the L10 fixed agenda with most time on IDS of top issues and a closing rating
Recommends someone besides the ED hold L10 discipline (internal Integrator or licensed EOS Implementer) and notes EOS terms are trademarked with certified rollout as a separate paid path

evals.prompt: help me write our core values for EOS. right now they're 'equity, compassion, excellence, community.' team says they're meaningless
evals.expected_output: Rewrites aspirational values as 3–5 observable behaviors usable in hiring, reviews and recognition, framed in mission-driven language.
assertions: Explains that values should be observable behaviors the org hires, fires, reviews and recognizes against rather than aspirational words
Proposes 3–5 rewritten values phrased as behaviors (e.g., 'we finish what we start')
Tests each value by whether it could be used in a hiring interview or performance conversation
Frames the work in mission-driven terms to avoid it reading as corporate jargon

evals.prompt: We're a brand-new $400K organization, 5 staff, no strategic plan, and I'm the founder doing fundraising, programs, finance AND HR. A consultant says EOS will fix everything. Also can we use the L10 format for our board meetings?
evals.expected_output: Cautions that EOS doesn't substitute for strategy, points to strategic planning first (or the V/TO 3-Year Picture as a lightweight substitute), names the founder holding many seats as the real capacity problem, and routes board meetings to board governance.
assertions: Warns that adopting EOS without a strategic plan risks running efficient meetings about unvalidated priorities, recommending strategic planning first or the V/TO 3-Year Picture as a lightweight parallel substitute
Names the founder occupying 3+ seats / Visionary-Integrator collapse as the presenting capacity problem that EOS structure alone won't fix without a staffing or delegation change
States that the L10 and Accountability Chart cover the staff leadership team and routes board meeting structure to the board governance skill
Recommends a conservative start (e.g., few Rocks) if they proceed

should_not_trigger.query: Our 3-year strategic plan expires next year — help me design the planning process and board retreat.
Build me a one-page KPI dashboard for the board with yellow/red thresholds each quarter.
